item.tib: zab lam mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzogs ma rgyud gsas mkhar sde lnga mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa'i thugs sgrub gsang ba gsang chen sgrub pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang raDa Na gling pa'am/ 'jam dpal rdo rje rtsal lam/ bdud 'dul gsang sngags grags pas/ gyim shod shel le rgya dkar nas gter du spyan drangs te/ sprul pa'i gter chen kun grol hUM chen 'gro 'dul pad ma gling pa nas khyod kyi bka' gter rnams mthar thon bgyis shig pa'-i bka' spyi bor phab pa dang*/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams kyi srid skyongs ra sbring ho thog thu mchog gi yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhas grub chen po bla ma gsan pu gcis thu 'jam dpal nor bu dpal bzang po nas rin gnyis TaM gsar thig pa'i grangs ldan rab dkar lha rdzas kyi bklubs pa bcas phran gyi zab gter rigs rnams 'phro lus ma song bar dus skabs 'bebs bkrol dgos pa'i gsung gsang spyi bor brtsal ba dang / nye bar spa ston g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang po dang*/ shag rigs rig 'dzin kun skyongs grags pa snang zhig nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la sogs las ldan du mas bskul ba brten/ slar shing phag gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bzang por shog ser bod yig tu phab ste/ drung yig pa ni tshul khrims blo ldan dang yi ge dang po'i byed po 'bru rigs g.yung drung dar rgyas nas bgyis pa gsang chen bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
